## During the seminar

We will distinguish conditional from marginal probabilities, examine
independence, and use the law of total probability. A hypothetical arrest tree
will provide the derivation of Bayes' rule before the break.

After the break, we will solve Monty Hall analytically and simulate the host's
actions. A model of competing coalitions will illustrate conditioning on a
first step and simulating a complete process. In each example, identify the
reference group used in the denominator of a conditional probability.
